risk_notes: CUDA Toolkit / nvcc version is not pinned; build reproducibility depends on whatever nvcc is on PATH.
Target GPU architecture (-arch=sm_70) is hard-coded; suggested alternatives (sm_75/80/86/90) are also unpinned and chosen at developer discretion.
cuda_runtime.h is a system header from the CUDA Toolkit install — no version constraint is declared in source, so ABI/runtime drift is possible across toolkit versions.
No package manager manifest (CMakeLists, Makefile, vcpkg/conan file) is provided, so dependency resolution is entirely implicit on the host environment.
